questions.question: TypeScript type system — structural typing là gì?

options.A: TypeScript dùng nominal typing như Java
options.B: Structural typing: type compatibility dựa trên shape (properties/methods), không phải tên. Duck typing at compile time — nếu object có đủ required properties thì compatible

questions.explanation: interface Point { x: number; y: number }. function printPoint(p: Point) { console.log(p.x, p.y) }. const point = { x: 10, y: 20, z: 30 }; printPoint(point); // OK — thêm z không vi phạm. type Name = { name: string }; type Age = { age: number }; type Person = Name & Age. class Cat { name: string; meow() {} }. class Dog { name: string; bark() {} }. function greet(animal: { name: string }) { console.log(animal.name) }. greet(new Cat()) // OK — Cat has 'name'. Nominal typing (NOT in TS): chỉ Cat extend Animal mới compatible với Animal.

questions.question: TypeScript union types và intersection types khác nhau thế nào?

options.B: Union (|): type A OR B — value must satisfy one type. Intersection (&): type A AND B — value must satisfy both types (merging)
options.C: Union là chỉ dùng với primitives
options.D: Intersection là không thể với object types

questions.explanation: Union: type StringOrNumber = string | number. function process(id: StringOrNumber) { if (typeof id === 'string') id.toUpperCase(); else id.toFixed() }. Discriminated union: type Shape = { kind: 'circle'; radius: number } | { kind: 'square'; side: number }. Intersection: type Admin = User & AdminPermissions — phải có tất cả properties của cả hai. type ReadOnly<T> = Readonly<T> & { readonly id: string }. Practical: type APIError = { code: number } & { message: string }. Width of value: union type có narrower value set (phải thỏa 1 trong), intersection rộng hơn (phải thỏa cả 2).

questions.question: TypeScript generics — tại sao cần và cách dùng cơ bản?

options.B: Generics tạo reusable components with type parameters: function identity<T>(arg: T): T — type-safe mà không mất flexibility; constraints với extends

questions.explanation: function identity<T>(arg: T): T { return arg }. identity<string>('hello') // hoặc identity('hello') — infer T=string. Generic interface: interface Container<T> { value: T; transform<U>(fn: (val: T) => U): Container<U> }. Constraint: function getLength<T extends { length: number }>(arg: T): number { return arg.length }. Multiple params: function pair<K, V>(key: K, value: V): [K, V] { return [key, value] }. Conditional: type NonNullable<T> = T extends null | undefined ? never : T. Default: function createArray<T = string>(length: number): T[] { return Array(length) }.

questions.question: TypeScript interface vs type alias — khi nào dùng gì?

options.B: Interface: extendable (declaration merging, extends), tốt cho objects/classes. Type alias: union/intersection/mapped types, primitives, tuples — không merge được
options.C: Type alias deprecated, chỉ dùng interface

questions.explanation: Interface: interface User { name: string }; interface Admin extends User { role: string }. Declaration merging: interface Window { myLib: any }; interface Window { anotherProp: string } — cả hai merge. Type alias: type ID = string | number. type Point = { x: number; y: number }. type Callback = () => void. Mapped type (chỉ type): type Partial<T> = { [P in keyof T]?: T[P] }. Conditional type (chỉ type): type IsString<T> = T extends string ? true : false. Recommendation: dùng interface cho public API, type cho complex type compositions.

questions.question: TypeScript utility types quan trọng nhất?

options.B: Partial<T>, Required<T>, Readonly<T>, Pick<T,K>, Omit<T,K>, Record<K,V>, ReturnType<F>, Parameters<F>, Awaited<T>, NonNullable<T>
options.D: Utility types chỉ cho advanced TypeScript

questions.explanation: Partial<T>: tất cả properties optional. Required<T>: tất cả required. Readonly<T>: no mutation. Pick<User, 'name'|'email'>: chỉ giữ selected keys. Omit<User, 'password'>: loại bỏ keys. Record<string, User>: dictionary. ReturnType<typeof fn>: lấy return type của function. Parameters<typeof fn>: tuple of param types. Awaited<Promise<string>>: string. Extract<'a'|'b'|'c', 'a'|'b'>: 'a'|'b'. Exclude<'a'|'b'|'c', 'a'>: 'b'|'c'. ConstructorParameters<typeof MyClass>. InstanceType<typeof MyClass>.

questions.question: TypeScript null và undefined handling — optional chaining và nullish coalescing?

options.B: strictNullChecks mode; optional chaining ?.  cho safe property access; nullish coalescing ?? cho fallback; non-null assertion !; type guards
options.C: Chỉ dùng if (x) để check null
options.D: null và undefined giống nhau trong TypeScript

questions.explanation: strictNullChecks: string vs string|null là khác nhau. Optional chaining: user?.address?.city — không throw nếu undefined, return undefined. Nullish coalescing: value ?? 'default' — chỉ fallback nếu null/undefined (khác || fallback on falsy). Non-null assertion: element!.textContent — 'tôi biết không null'. Type guard: if (user !== null && user !== undefined). Type predicate: function isUser(x: any): x is User { return 'name' in x }. Optional property: interface User { email?: string } — email: string | undefined. Nullish assignment: user.name ??= 'Anonymous'.

questions.question: TypeScript conditional types và template literal types?

options.B: Conditional types: T extends U ? X : Y; infer keyword để extract types; template literal types: `${string}Event`; distributive conditional types
options.D: Template literal types chỉ cho strings

questions.explanation: Conditional type: type IsArray<T> = T extends any[] ? true : false. infer: type UnpackPromise<T> = T extends Promise<infer R> ? R : T. type ReturnType<T extends (...args: any) => any> = T extends (...args: any) => infer R ? R : any. Distributive: type ToArray<T> = T extends any ? T[] : never; ToArray<string|number> = string[]|number[]. Template literal: type EventName = `on${Capitalize<string>}`; type CSS = `${number}px` | `${number}%`. Combine: type Getters<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${Capitalize<string & K>}`]: () => T[K] }.

questions.question: TypeScript mapped types — `keyof`, `in keyof`, modifiers?

options.B: Mapped types iterate over keyof T; +?/-? để add/remove optional; +readonly/-readonly; remapping với as; keyof để get union of keys

questions.explanation: type MyPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] }. type MyRequired<T> = { [K in keyof T]-?: T[K] }. type MyReadonly<T> = { +readonly [K in keyof T]: T[K] }. Remap với as: type Getters<T> = { [K in keyof T as `get${Capitalize<string & K>}`]: () => T[K] }. Filter keys: type PickByValue<T, V> = { [K in keyof T as T[K] extends V ? K : never]: T[K] }. keyof T: union of all keys. T[keyof T]: union of all value types. type Values<T> = T[keyof T].

questions.question: TypeScript type narrowing — các techniques?

options.B: typeof, instanceof, in operator, equality checks, truthiness, discriminated unions, user-defined type guards (x is T), assertion functions
options.D: Type narrowing chỉ với union types

questions.explanation: typeof: if (typeof x === 'string') x.toUpperCase(). instanceof: if (err instanceof TypeError). in: if ('swim' in animal). Equality: if (x === null). Truthiness: if (x) { // x không phải null/undefined/0/'' }. Discriminated union: switch (shape.kind) { case 'circle': ... case 'square': ... }. Type predicate: function isAdmin(user: User): user is Admin { return 'adminLevel' in user }. Assertion: function assert(condition: any, msg: string): asserts condition { if (!condition) throw new Error(msg) }. never type: exhaustive check trong switch default.

questions.question: TypeScript decorators — khi nào dùng và cách implement?

options.B: Class/method/property decorators — metadata annotation; dùng trong frameworks (NestJS, TypeORM); experimentalDecorators hoặc TC39 stage 3 decorators

questions.explanation: experimentalDecorators (legacy): @Component({ selector: 'app' }). Class decorator: function sealed(constructor: Function) { Object.seal(constructor) }. Method decorator: function log(target, key, descriptor) { const orig = descriptor.value; descriptor.value = function(...args) { console.log('calling', key); return orig.apply(this, args) }; return descriptor }. TC39 Stage 3 (TS 5.0+): class C { @logged accessor x = 0; @validate isValid() { ... } }. Property decorator: @Column(), @IsEmail() (class-validator). Parameter decorator: @Body(), @Param() (NestJS).

questions.question: TypeScript module system và declaration files (.d.ts)?

options.B: .d.ts files: type declarations without implementation; ambient declarations; @types packages; module augmentation; declare module cho JS libraries
options.C: d.ts files chỉ cho third-party libraries

questions.explanation: .d.ts: type information only, không có implementation. Usage: khi wrap JS code với TypeScript types, hoặc publish typed npm package (types field in package.json). Ambient: declare const API_URL: string (từ window). declare module 'some-untyped-lib' { export function doSomething(): void }. @types packages: npm i -D @types/node @types/react — community type definitions. Module augmentation: declare module 'express' { interface Request { user?: User } }. tsconfig.json: typeRoots, types để control which @types loaded. isolatedDeclarations: faster d.ts generation.

questions.question: TypeScript strict mode — các options quan trọng?

options.A: strict mode không có lợi ích thực tế
options.B: strict: true enable: strictNullChecks, strictFunctionTypes, noImplicitAny, strictPropertyInitialization, useUnknownInCatchVariables, noUncheckedIndexedAccess
options.D: strict mode làm code khó viết hơn không đáng

questions.explanation: strict: true = combine nhiều strict options. strictNullChecks: null/undefined không assignable to other types. noImplicitAny: error nếu TypeScript không thể infer type. strictFunctionTypes: contravariance for function params. strictPropertyInitialization: class properties phải initialized in constructor. useUnknownInCatchVariables: catch clause là unknown thay vì any (TS 4.4+). noUncheckedIndexedAccess: array[i] có type T|undefined. exactOptionalPropertyTypes: optional props không accept undefined explicitly (TS 4.4+). noImplicitReturns: tất cả code paths phải return. noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.

questions.question: Implement type-safe API client với TypeScript generics?

options.A: TypeScript không thể make API calls type-safe
options.B: Generic fetch wrapper: fetch<T>(url): Promise<T>; response_model types; Zod schema validation at runtime; type-safe error handling
options.C: Chỉ cần any type cho API responses
options.D: OpenAPI generator là duy nhất option

questions.explanation: async function apiFetch<T>(url: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...options?.headers } }); if (!response.ok) { const error = await response.json(); throw new APIError(response.status, error.message) }; return response.json() as Promise<T> }. Usage: const user = await apiFetch<User>('/api/users/1'). Zod validation: const UserSchema = z.object({ id: z.number(), name: z.string() }); type User = z.infer<typeof UserSchema>. async function fetchUser(id: number): Promise<User> { const data = await apiFetch<unknown>(`/api/users/${id}`); return UserSchema.parse(data) }.

questions.question: TypeScript discriminated unions cho Redux/state management?

options.A: TypeScript không phù hợp cho state management
options.B: Discriminated unions cho action types: { type: 'FETCH_USER' } | { type: 'USER_LOADED', payload: User } — exhaustive switch, narrow payload type

questions.explanation: type Action = | { type: 'FETCH_USER'; id: string } | { type: 'USER_LOADED'; payload: User } | { type: 'USER_ERROR'; error: string }. function reducer(state: State, action: Action): State { switch (action.type) { case 'FETCH_USER': return { ...state, loading: true, userId: action.id }; // action.id: string case 'USER_LOADED': return { ...state, loading: false, user: action.payload }; // action.payload: User case 'USER_ERROR': return { ...state, loading: false, error: action.error }; default: const _exhaustive: never = action; // compile error if unhandled return state } }. createAction helper. RTK với immer + TS generics.

questions.question: Implement deep readonly và immutable types trong TypeScript?

options.B: DeepReadonly recursive mapped type; as const assertion; Readonly<T> chỉ shallow; Immutable.js hoặc immer cho runtime immutability

questions.explanation: DeepReadonly: type DeepReadonly<T> = T extends (infer U)[] ? ReadonlyArray<DeepReadonly<U>> : T extends object ? { readonly [K in keyof T]: DeepReadonly<T[K]> } : T. as const: const config = { host: 'localhost', port: 3000 } as const; config.host = 'other' // Error. const COLORS = ['red', 'green', 'blue'] as const; type Color = typeof COLORS[number]; // 'red' | 'green' | 'blue'. Readonly<T>: shallow — nested objects still mutable. Type-level immutability vs runtime: Readonly prevents TS mutation but not JS. Runtime: Object.freeze(deep) hoặc immer produce().

questions.question: TypeScript với React — proper typing patterns?

options.B: FC<Props> hoặc function với typed props; useState<T>; useRef<HTMLElement>; event types (ChangeEvent, MouseEvent); forwardRef; generic components

questions.explanation: Component: interface ButtonProps { onClick: () => void; children: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }. function Button({ onClick, children, disabled = false }: ButtonProps): JSX.Element. useState: const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null). useRef: const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null); inputRef.current?.focus(). Event: onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setVal(e.target.value)}. forwardRef: React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>((props, ref) => <button ref={ref} {...props} />). Generic component: function List<T>({ items, renderItem }: { items: T[]; renderItem: (item: T) => React.ReactNode }). useContext với type: const ctx = useContext(UserContext) as User.

questions.question: TypeScript type narrowing với zod — runtime validation + types?

options.B: Zod schema → infer<typeof Schema> cho TypeScript types; parse() throws ZodError; safeParse() returns {success, data, error}; transform và refine

questions.explanation: const UserSchema = z.object({ id: z.number().int().positive(), name: z.string().min(1).max(100), email: z.string().email(), role: z.enum(['admin', 'user']).default('user'), createdAt: z.coerce.date() }); type User = z.infer<typeof UserSchema>. Parse: const user = UserSchema.parse(rawData); // throws ZodError if invalid. Safe: const result = UserSchema.safeParse(rawData); if (!result.success) { result.error.errors }; else { result.data }. Transform: z.string().transform(s => s.toLowerCase()). Refine: z.string().refine(s => s.startsWith('user_'), 'Must start with user_'). Discriminated: z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...]).

questions.question: TypeScript module augmentation và global types?

options.A: Module augmentation không thể trong TypeScript
options.B: Declare module 'lib' để add types; augment global Window/process; extend Express Request; declare global { } trong module files
options.C: Chỉ dùng any cho third-party types
options.D: Global types không support trong TypeScript

questions.explanation: Extend Express Request: declare global { namespace Express { interface Request { user?: User; requestId: string } } }. Augment third-party: declare module 'lodash' { interface LoDashStatic { customMethod(): void } }. Global Window: declare global { interface Window { analytics: Analytics; grecaptcha: ReCaptchaV2.ReCaptcha } }. Extend process.env: declare global { namespace NodeJS { interface ProcessEnv { DATABASE_URL: string; API_KEY: string; NODE_ENV: 'development'|'production'|'test' } } }. ambient module: declare module '*.svg' { const content: string; export default content } — import SVGs as strings.

questions.question: TypeScript 'Type instantiation is excessively deep' error — nguyên nhân và fix?

options.B: Recursive generic types lặp quá sâu — TypeScript có limit 100 levels; fix bằng cách simplify recursion, add base case, hoặc tăng recursion limit

questions.explanation: Cause: type DeepNested<T, N extends number = 0> = N extends 10 ? T : { value: T; nested: DeepNested<T, [...Array<N>, 0]['length']> }. TS limit: ~100 type instantiations deep. Fix: (1) Add union with any as escape hatch. (2) Reduce nesting depth. (3) @ts-ignore (last resort). (4) Use different algorithm — e.g., iteration instead of recursion. (5) Simplify mapped type chains. Common culprit: deeply nested conditional types in utility library. Check: tsc --traceResolution để xem resolution. tsconfig.json: no option to increase limit directly. Practical: limit recursive types to needed depth.

questions.question: TypeScript type errors với 'any' leaking — cách detect và fix?

options.A: any là giải pháp cho mọi type errors
options.B: noImplicitAny, @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, noImplicitReturns, strict mode; replace any với unknown và use type guards; generic functions
options.C: any không gây ra vấn đề thực tế
options.D: TypeScript tự convert any về correct types

questions.explanation: any propagation: function parseJSON(data: any) { return data.user.name } → return type là any → spreads to caller. Fix: function parseJSON(data: string): unknown { return JSON.parse(data) } → caller phải narrow. ESLint: @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any rule. Detect: noImplicitAny tsconfig. Replace patterns: (1) any → unknown (force type checking). (2) any[] → T[] (generics). (3) Record<string, any> → Record<string, unknown>. (4) Function params: (x: any) → <T>(x: T). (5) third-party: @types package hoặc declare module. Check coverage: typescript-coverage-report tool.

questions.question: TypeScript compile time vs runtime — type erasure issues?

options.A: TypeScript types tồn tại ở runtime
options.B: TypeScript types bị erased tại runtime (compiled to JS); instanceof checks class, không interface; typeof chỉ primitives; cần Zod/class-transformer cho runtime validation
options.C: Type assertions đảm bảo runtime safety

questions.explanation: Type erasure: interface User { name: string } → sau compile không còn User. Cannot: if (obj instanceof User) // Error — interface không tồn tại runtime. Can: if (obj instanceof MyClass) // class tồn tại. Type assertions: const x = json as User — KHÔNG validate, chỉ tell TypeScript. Dangerous: function processUser(user: User) { // user might not actually be User at runtime }. Safe patterns: (1) Zod parse: UserSchema.parse(data) → validated User. (2) class-transformer: plainToClass(User, data). (3) Type guard function với manual checks. (4) io-ts. Reflection: TypeScript decorators có thể emit metadata (emitDecoratorMetadata).

questions.question: TypeScript circular type references — cách handle?

options.A: Circular types không thể trong TypeScript
options.B: Interface circular references OK; type alias circular cần interface workaround hoặc JSON schema approach; tree data structures
options.D: Chỉ dùng any cho circular types

questions.explanation: Interface circular (OK): interface TreeNode { value: number; children: TreeNode[] }. Type alias circular: type TreeNode = { value: number; children: TreeNode[] } — OK in modern TS (4.1+). JSON-like: type JSONValue = string | number | boolean | null | JSONValue[] | { [key: string]: JSONValue }. Error case: type A = { b: B }; type B = { a: A } — fine if not instantiated infinitely. Problem: type MyPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]: MyPartial<T[K]> } — can hit recursion limit. Fix: add base case. Graph: interface Node { edges: Node[] } — OK. Self-reference in generics: type DeepPartial<T> = { [P in keyof T]?: T[P] extends object ? DeepPartial<T[P]> : T[P] }.

questions.question: TypeScript narrowing không hoạt động — common pitfalls?

options.B: Closure in async context, spread losing type info, mutable variables, stale closures; const assertion, immediate call, re-checking after async

questions.explanation: Async pitfall: if (user !== null) { setTimeout(() => { user.name // Error: Object is possibly null } ,0) }. TypeScript không track narrowing qua async boundaries. Fix: const localUser = user; setTimeout(() => localUser.name). Reassignment: let x: string | null; if (x !== null) { x = null; x.length // Error }. Destructuring: const { name } = user // name: string|undefined even after check. Fix: const { name } = user!. Mutable object props: function check(obj: { x: string|null }) { if (obj.x !== null) { doAsync().then(() => obj.x.length // Error — x could be reassigned }) }. Fix: const { x } = obj khi còn narrow.

questions.question: TypeScript performance — slow type checking, cách optimize?

options.B: project references, incremental compilation, skipLibCheck, isolatedModules, avoid complex mapped types, measure với tsc --diagnostics

questions.explanation: Diagnose: tsc --diagnostics → xem thời gian per phase. --extendedDiagnostics → detailed breakdown. Optimization: (1) project references: chia large project thành sub-projects với references → incremental checks. (2) incremental: true → .tsbuildinfo → chỉ re-check changed files. (3) skipLibCheck: true → skip type checking node_modules .d.ts. (4) isolatedModules: true → faster per-file transform (required for Babel/SWC). (5) Avoid complex types: recursive conditional types expensive. (6) typeRoots: explicitly list @types folders. (7) exclude: node_modules, dist. VSCode: TypeScript version + restart server khi chậm. Measure: @typescript-eslint slow rules.

questions.question: TypeScript monorepo — sharing types giữa packages?

options.A: Types không thể share trong monorepo
options.B: Shared @company/types package; project references; turbo/nx build pipelines; tsconfig base; workspace protocols trong pnpm/yarn

questions.explanation: Monorepo structure: packages/types/ (shared interfaces, DTOs), packages/api/ (Express/NestJS), packages/web/ (React), packages/mobile/ (React Native). Shared types package: @company/types — export all interfaces, enums, DTOs. packages/api package.json: { dependencies: { '@company/types': 'workspace:*' } }. tsconfig.json: { extends: '../../tsconfig.base.json', references: [{ path: '../types' }] }. Base tsconfig: strict settings, paths, etc. Build: turbo.json pipeline với dependencies: packages/types must build before packages/api. Type validation at API boundary: Zod parse incoming data to known types.

questions.question: TypeScript migrate từ JavaScript — strategy?

options.A: Phải migrate tất cả cùng lúc
options.B: Incremental: allowJs + checkJs, rename .js→.ts gradually, any for hard-to-type parts, strict mode roadmap, TypeScript codemods
options.C: Chỉ cần đổi extension là đủ
options.D: TypeScript không backward compatible với JavaScript

questions.explanation: Migration roadmap: (1) Start: tsconfig.json với allowJs:true, checkJs:false, strict:false. (2) Rename files: .js→.ts one by one. (3) Type errors: thêm types, dùng any liberally ở đầu. (4) Fix any: gradually replace với proper types. (5) Enable strict options one by one: strictNullChecks → noImplicitAny → ... (6) Generate types: ts-migrate tool (từ Airbnb). (7) @ts-nocheck cho temporarily excluded files. (8) JSDoc: add types in .js files without rename. CI: noEmitOnError:false during migration. Goal: greenfield new code strict, legacy code gradually migrated. Test coverage trước migration để ensure no regressions.

questions.question: Build TypeScript library để publish lên npm — best practices?

options.B: Compile to CommonJS + ESM (dual package); generate .d.ts; tsup/rollup bundler; exports field trong package.json; bundle size optimization

questions.explanation: tsup (recommended): tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts. package.json: { main: './dist/index.js', module: './dist/index.mjs', types: './dist/index.d.ts', exports: { '.': { import: './dist/index.mjs', require: './dist/index.js', types: './dist/index.d.ts' } }, files: ['dist'] }. tsconfig.json: strict:true, declaration:true, declarationMap:true. API design: avoid internal types leaking, stable public API. Test: vitest, @testing-library. Versioning: SemVer, breaking changes in major. Bundle size: tree-shakeable (ESM), no side effects. publint để validate package.json.

questions.question: TypeScript với end-to-end type safety — full-stack approach?

options.B: tRPC hoặc OpenAPI codegen để share types server→client; Zod schemas làm source of truth; type-safe API calls, validated at boundaries
options.C: Copy-paste types giữa frontend và backend

questions.explanation: tRPC approach: Server: const appRouter = router({ users: router({ getUser: procedure.input(z.object({ id: z.number() })).query(({ input }) => db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: input.id } })) }) }). Client: const trpc = createTRPCClient<AppRouter>({ ... }); const user = await trpc.users.getUser.query({ id: 1 }) — fully typed, no manual types. OpenAPI: NestJS/FastAPI → generate openapi.json → openapi-typescript CLI → types.ts → typed fetch client. Zod DTOs: share same Zod schemas between frontend form validation và backend API validation → guaranteed match. Prisma: client types auto-generated from schema.

questions.question: TypeScript advanced patterns — builder pattern, fluent API, brand types?

options.A: Design patterns không áp dụng trong TypeScript
options.B: Builder: chained methods với type narrowing; fluent API types; brand types (opaque types) để prevent mixing similar primitives
options.D: Brand types không possible trong TypeScript

questions.explanation: Brand types: type UserId = string & { readonly _brand: 'UserId' }; function createUserId(id: string): UserId { return id as UserId }. const orderId: OrderId = createUserId('123') // Error — không thể mix. Builder pattern with type narrowing: class QueryBuilder<T extends Record<string, unknown>> { where<K extends keyof T>(key: K, value: T[K]): QueryBuilder<T> { ... }; build(): Query<T> { ... } }. Fluent: type Chain<T> = { value: T; map<U>(fn: (t: T) => U): Chain<U>; get(): T }. Type-level computation: type Add<A extends number, B extends number> = [...Tuple<A>, ...Tuple<B>]['length']. satisfies operator (TS 4.9): value satisfies Type — check type without widening.

questions.question: TypeScript ESLint configuration cho enterprise project?

options.B: @typescript-eslint/parser, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, type-checked rules, prettier integration, husky pre-commit, CI enforcement
options.D: Chỉ cần TSC để check types

questions.explanation: Setup: eslint.config.mjs với @typescript-eslint/parser, parserOptions.project: './tsconfig.json'. Recommended rulesets: @typescript-eslint/recommended (basic), @typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked (type-checked, slower). Key rules: no-explicit-any, no-unsafe-call, no-unsafe-return, no-floating-promises (critical — catch unhandled promises), no-misused-promises, consistent-type-imports, naming-convention. Prettier: eslint-config-prettier để avoid conflicts. Ignore: tsconfig.json excluded files should be in eslint ignore. Performance: typeRoots/project settings. husky + lint-staged: run ESLint on changed files pre-commit. CI: eslint --max-warnings 0.
